component.name: SubMagician
component.summary: Find, fix and sync subtitles for your videos

description.p: SubMagician finds the subtitle made for each of your videos, fixes its text and syncs it to the audio, then saves it next to the video, where every player finds it.

ul.li: Searches OpenSubtitles, SubDL and Addic7ed and picks the subtitle that fits your exact file, not just its name
Fixes broken characters and saves everything as UTF-8
Syncs subtitles to the speech in seconds: offset, frame rate and cut scenes
Uses subtitles inside the video, or writes one from the audio with Whisper, on your computer
Works on whole folders, watches them for new videos, and adds itself to the file manager's right-click menu
Plugins for mpv and VLC, and a command-line tool

screenshot.caption: A folder of episodes with their subtitles, and the subtitles found for one
Fixing the timing of a subtitle
Player plugins for mpv and VLC

description.p: Writing subtitles from the audio works on any 64-bit PC from 2013 on; a simpler window with flags, clearer buttons with tooltips; right-click menu entries to choose; a dialog when something crashes; Fedora and Flatpak packages.
